newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Boral shares build on better outlook.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Boral shares build on better outlook.

text.p: Investor hopes of a better outlook for the building materials sector boosted Boral Ltd to a three year high of A$3.85 in morning trade on Friday.

Despite a sharply lower first half net profit of A$93.16 million reported on Wednesday, the company said it expected an upturn in the home building sector to raise prices and margins for the group's products.

The upbeat assessment of the cyclical group's prospects overflowed to other major sector constituents. Pioneer International was up 10.4 cents to A$4.16, its highest level since October 1987, and CSR Ltd shares up eight cents to A$4.75, a 20 month high.

"People seem to be zeroing in on comments coming from Boral," said head of equities at a Sydney brokerage, noting that while Boral's interim result was far from impressive, investors seemed to be focussing further out.
"If, at long last, they are seeing a light at the end of the tunnel, then the opportunities for significant profit growth are pretty good."

By 12.05 p.m. (0100 GMT), Boral shares had gone further ahead to be up 20 cents at A$3.87 on turnover of 1.9 million shares, CSR shares were up seven at A$4.74 on turnover of 799,843 shares while Pioneer shares were 10.4 cents higher at A$4.16 with 684,530 shares traded.
